name: generic-amd
notes: Any laptop with an AMD processor that no model-specific profile names. A laptop that joins with a code lands here until somebody adds a profile for its model.
disko: LUKS2 on /dev/nvme0n1, btrfs with / /home /nix and swap, 512 MB ESP (the core's single-nvme-luks layout)
